audience: Brazilian small businesses that run sales, purchases and finances in eGestor

useCases.title: See which customer payments are still open
useCases.text: List the receivables that are open and due in a date range. Ask the assistant to sort them by due date and total the amount you wait to receive.

useCases.title: Plan the bills you must pay this month
useCases.text: List the open payables for a date range and open one for the detail. Add the financial accounts to check which cash box or bank account can cover them.

useCases.title: Summarize last week's sales
useCases.text: List the sales of a date range, filtered by contact if you want. Open one sale to read its items, payments and totals. Ask for a short summary.

useCases.title: Check products, prices and stock
useCases.text: List the products with their prices and stock data. Open one product for the full record, and list the services the company sells.

useCases.title: Review purchases from a supplier
useCases.text: List the purchases of a date range and open one to read its data. Use the contact list to find the supplier code first.

useCases.title: Add a new customer as a contact
useCases.text: Search the contacts to check that the person is not in eGestor yet. Then create the contact as a customer, supplier or carrier and read back the new code.
